analysis_breakdown: Report model-level scores and separate c1 (actor parameter offload enabled) from c2/c3 (disabled), including unresolved approvals. Do not attribute c1 recovery to successful prediction of resident-actor settings. Mark the ten targets with mismatched donor GPU counts: six four-GPU c1 targets and four four-GPU code targets at c2/c3. These transfer GPU count as well as model.
cache_policy: Fresh process/Ray namespace/scratch/compiler cache each period; shared immutable cached model/data. OS page cache, host contention and thermal carryover remain.
comparison: Two/four task GPUs within the same four-GPU allocation, TP1 and fixed global prompt batch. Generated sequences may differ; this is total execution effect.
completion: Zero wrapper/trial exit, nonempty immutable raw console, exact durable metric from real LocalLogger after normal print, complete physical-device worker coverage, source/model/data/stack provenance, complete traces and trainer lifecycle. Never synthesize a metric or use an old exit-only/log-free completion rule.
cost_scope: Historical source acquisition reported separately with zero incremental source GPU collection; CPU prediction separately. New task-provisioned GPU seconds, four-GPU invocation reservation and actual whole-allocation accounting are distinct. Failures/missing outcomes remain in costs; scheduled EndTime is never actual cost.
diagnostic_visibility: Parent separately runs a Qwen7/GSM8K/c2/four-GPU diagnostic with seed191 to check durable capture. It is excluded from fitting, selection, target slots and costs here. CPU prompt-format and filtering checks are visible before freezing; their outputs do not enter predictors. No Mistral training or GPU-memory outcomes precede this new forecast freeze.
donor_rule: Same original workload and compound level; prefer same GPU count, then same family, then absolute log parameter-count distance, then configuration_id. Mistral is explicitly a new family: all historical candidates mismatch its family, so fall back to GPU count, parameter distance, and ID. Qwen predictions must reproduce exactly.
failure_policy: One permanent pair claim in the canonical raw root. No retry/requeue/replacement. Continue period two after any outcome only with successful cleanup, all-four-device idle gates, and a full 1500-second slot plus cleanup reserve remaining.

implementation_refreeze.scope: Only Ray worker-log retention implementation and its source/execution seal are superseded before evaluation. Correct RAY_TMPDIR nesting and container session_latest symlink handling after separate diagnostics. Initial matrix, forecasts, scientific settings, data and label rules stay unchanged. Diagnostic outcomes never enter fitting or settings.

interpretation: Outcome-motivated new measurement implementation after visibility of the two old panels. Both historical panels retain their original per-configuration labels and unresolved statuses and remain separate from this cohort. This is prospective fresh-seed replication; no retrospective rescue or unseen model selection.

outcome_rule: Three eligible distinct new seeds required per configuration. Any validated memory failure implies memory_failure; else max completed peak >38912 MiB implies above_margin; else within_margin. Missing/invalid/timeout slots remain unresolved. Partial known failure/margin flags remain visible; no peak imputation for failure.
predictions: Reuse original 90-configuration fitted_model.json verbatim; no refit, retune, target outcomes, measured lengths, or new-panel outcomes enter prediction.
randomization: 27 two-first and 27 four-first; 2:1 within each three-seed cell. Each two-of-four subset appears nine times; pair collection order separately shuffled.
source_closure_policy: Freeze the full existing non-test Python execution/collector closure, all essential completion/logger/device/allocator hooks, and populated pinned TransferQueue Python bytes. Verify exactly those sealed relative names thereafter. Unrelated later additions are allowed; changes to any sealed file require replay from an archived source snapshot containing the original bytes. Archive that snapshot with the protocol and raw evidence.

source_cost.interpretation: Historical evidence acquisition, not incremental GPU execution or a cold-start cost saving.
